title: Trapped with Bi Yao in the Dixue Cave
summary: A Black Water Snake attacks, and Zhang Xiaofan draws it away so Lu Xueqi can escape. Bi Yao saves him, and the two end up trapped together in the snake's tunnels while Lu Xueqi rejoins Qi Hao and the others. Xiaofan has a broken bone and calls Bi Yao a devil; they bicker and wander the dead-end tunnels until he notices a bleeding rock. It opens into the Dixue Cave, where they find the corpse of Black Heart Elder, the Blood-Refining Hall master of 800 years ago, but no treasure. Xiaofan falls into a fever and relives the massacre of his village, and Bi Yao learns he is an orphan and keeps him warm. Outside, the search party finds nothing after many days; Lu Xueqi wants to keep looking, but the others decide to go back and ask the sect leader for trackers. Xiaofan recovers, a skull falls and opens a hidden passage, and they find a poem of regret and the statues of the Wisdom King and the Holy Mother.
